parsed.explanation: Combined national-state regime imposes universal border/document and many public-facility exposures: X/mismatched passports no longer issued, Supreme Court allowed restriction, entry cable directs refusal on sex discrepancy and consideration of permanent fraud ineligibility, and federal plus 21-22 state facility bans operate by birth sex with one documented trespass arrest and men's-ward holding. No presentation sweeps, execution, or documented fraud imposition; many states have no mapped ban, 22 plus capital outlaw gender-identity discrimination, hate-crimes law exists, and courts have enjoined some orders. Custody-abuse claims are single-source and uncorroborated. Result is unremedied tier-1 exposure mitigated by functioning courts and geographically uneven protections.

entry_documents.exposure: X-marker passports stopped for new issue, restrictions allowed by Supreme Court Nov 2025; entry cable directs refusal where documents cast doubt on sex and consideration of permanent fraud ground for wilful misrepresentation. Foreign advisories issued.
entry_documents.protection: Existing X passports remain valid until expiration; fraud finding requires four elements, not automatic, limited waivers possible. Passport policy challenged in court.
entry_documents.interaction: Document discrepancy can escalate from refusal to fraud scrutiny and permanent ineligibility, interacting with state document-invalidating laws.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: Recission of prison LGBTQ protections; single-source uncorroborated reports of conversion-style policies, hormone removal, immigration-custody forced labour, beatings and sexual abuse. One arrestee held 24h in men's ward.
investigation_detention_custody.protection: Not documented. No documented custody remedy or placement protocol in dossier.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: Trespass or fraud investigation can lead to birth-sex custody placement; uncorroborated abuse claims are uncertain, not established pattern.

federal_state_facilities.exposure: Federal order bars government-funded single-sex facilities congruent with identity; 9+1 states ban in all government buildings, 9 in schools plus some government buildings, 3 schools-only, 6 extend to some private settings, 4 criminalise in certain circumstances.
federal_state_facilities.protection: 29 states, 4 territories and capital district have no ban in mapped categories; several federal orders blocked/enjoined; exemptions in trespass statute.
federal_state_facilities.interaction: National rule applies regardless of protective state law for federal buildings; state bans add exposure in ban states, with no remedy documented to override them.

care_services.exposure: Children's gender-affirming care banned in 27 states; proposed federal reimbursement bar for under-18s is proposed not final; January 2025 order frames care as mutilation.
care_services.protection: Not documented for adult visitor emergency or medication access. Several orders enjoined.
care_services.interaction: Adult visitor care exposure is not_documented; travelling minor's care access would be restricted in ban states if sought, and school pronoun/transition directives create institutional hostility.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: Executive order defines sex as binary at birth, removes gender-ideology materials, directs scrutiny of schools; Dec 2025 bounty memo and May 2026 strategy frame 'radically pro-transgender' actors for prioritisation. No posted reward documented.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: Counterterrorism strategy states powers not for mere disagreement; courts have blocked some orders.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: Official threat framing raises outing and investigation probability, but dossier documents no sweeps, raids or systematic arrest campaign for presentation.

minors_guardians.exposure: School facility bans; order directs investigation/prosecution of teachers facilitating social transition including pronouns; minor care bans in 27 states. Guardian exposure arises if family seeks school access or care.
minors_guardians.protection: Many states have no mapped school facility ban; no documented visitor-family shield.
minors_guardians.interaction: Minor travelling with guardian faces state-varying school/facility and care restrictions; adult guardian not documented as targeted for accompaniment exemptions in trespass statute.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: Poll: 66% support assigned-sex on documents. One documented bathroom arrest, handcuffed, charged trespass. No trans-specific violence rate documented; no comparison to homicide baseline possible.
street_violence_police_response.protection: National hate-crimes statute covers gender identity; 22 states plus capital outlaw discrimination; civil-liberties litigation active.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: Police are both potential protectors under hate-crime law and enforcers of trespass/facility rules; single arrest does not establish rate.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: Passport litigation unresolved; Supreme Court allowed key restriction; complaints have not secured facility access in ban regimes. Custody placement, airport screening treatment, adult care access largely not_documented.
remedies_unknowns.protection: Courts enjoined several orders, ACLU suit pending, anti-discrimination protections in many states operate as law on books.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Working courts partially mitigate, but do not cancel operative passport, entry and facility rules allowed to take effect; absence of data is not safety.

anchor_checks.comparison: Similar: universal birth-sex public-facility rule with courts upholding it and no effective remedy; here national entry/passport exposure and federal facilities make it at least as severe, while non-ban states and enjoined orders keep it from lower.

Similar tier-1 facility exposure, but this case is materially broader than Denvara: national passport/entry refusal and fraud consideration, multi-state criminal trespass provision and documented men's-ward holding push below 0.45 toward 0.38.

Higher safety than this case: Avalet has accepted foreign/X documents, no facility exclusion, corrected refusals and convictions for attackers, with only friction and uneven complaints; those operating protections and absent universal exposures are not documented here.

parsed.synthesis: Interaction is decisive: a mismatched or X passport meets a national binary rule, entry officers are directed to refuse and assess fraud, and any resulting detention or facility encounter occurs under birth-sex rules in federal and many state settings. Protective state laws, hate-crime coverage and court injunctions help in non-ban jurisdictions but do not pre-empt federal entry, federal facilities or state criminal trespass rules. Uncorroborated custody claims and absent violence/care data add uncertainty without proving safety. Hence elevated-to-high risk, above organised-targeting levels but below jurisdictions with only friction and working remedies.
